title: Split testing
description: Send a share of this app's visitors to a branch deploy or a retained release. Each visitor keeps the same variant through a cookie, which is only set while a test runs.
loadError: Could not load the split test: {{message}}
unsupportedTitle: Split testing is not available for this app
unsupportedHelp: It works for container apps with a domain. Static sites are not supported yet.

empty.title: No split test is running
empty.body: Pick a branch deploy or a retained release, give it a share of visitors, and compare request counts before promoting the winner.

start.title: Start a split test
start.noBranches: No ready branch deploys. Enable branch deploys and push a branch first.
start.label: Variant label
start.cookieTtlHelp: Such as 720h. Leave empty to use the server default.
start.errorTitle: Could not start the split test

table.caption: Variants of the running split test
table.overshoot: The variants take more than 100%, lower a weight.
table.qaHelp: Opening the QA link forces that variant for your browser and keeps it.
table.unavailableHelp: This variant is not reachable, so its visitors are served production.

cookie.summary: Cookie {{name}}, lasts {{hours}} hours. Add ?{{param}}=<variant> to a URL to force a variant.

stop.title: Stop the split test?
stop.body: Every visitor is served production again. Request counts are kept.

promote.title: Promote {{label}}?
promote.body: {{label}} becomes the production deploy through the normal deploy path, then the test ends.
promote.locked: This is refused while publishing is locked for the app.
